title: Enforcement surfaces
summary: chock compile and its emitters: which emitter writes each surface, and the file chock sync installs for it.
intro: A surface is where a compiled control runs. chock compile hands each policy to one emitter per surface; chock sync then installs what the emitters wrote. Each arrow out of chock compile names the surfaces that emitter writes, as the engine's compiler maps them.

boundaries.label: What runs it: chock sync and chock gateway run

nodes.label: chock compile
nodes.card: Runs each surface's emitter on a policy, in the engine's surface order, and writes what it emits to .chock/compiled/<id>/<surface>/. The gateway surface has no emitter: it is modeled for budgets and egress, not emitted.

nodes.label: Git hook emitter
nodes.card: Emits git-hook entrypoints from the policy's implementations folder: guards at pre-commit, pre-merge-commit and pre-push. Hard at commit and push; git commit --no-verify skips it.

nodes.label: CI emitter
nodes.card: Emits a CI gate step that re-runs the policy's check over a pull request's commit range: the backstop for a skipped git hook.

nodes.label: In-agent emitter
nodes.card: Hook fragments for every wired vendor. pre-tool-use refuses a call before it runs. stop reads what the turn left in the worktree and earns no coverage word. agent-hooks is the same deny for Copilot CLI and VS Code agent mode.

nodes.label: Managed settings
nodes.card: Emits Claude managed-settings.json fragments. There is no installer, so it enforces nothing today.

nodes.label: Ambient rule
nodes.card: Emits the AGENTS.md block the agent is asked to follow. Advisory: it blocks nothing on its own.

nodes.label: MCP gateway
nodes.card: Emits the gate specs the MCP proxy evaluates per tool call. It governs MCP-routed tool calls only.

nodes.label: Git hooks
nodes.card: chock sync installs a dispatcher in .git/hooks. It runs every executable script for the event.

nodes.label: CI workflow
nodes.card: chock sync --ci writes .github/workflows/chock.yml. Until then ci-gate is compiled and inert, and the coverage report says so.

nodes.label: Agent hook files
nodes.card: chock sync writes each wired agent's hook file, in that agent's own format. What happens when a hook cannot run is agentseam's data, listed below.

nodes.label: INDEX.md
nodes.card: chock sync compiles every active rule into .agents/policies/INDEX.md. AGENTS.md holds one pointer to it.

nodes.label: Gateway proxy
nodes.card: A stdio proxy the client launches instead of the real MCP server; it refuses matching tools/call payloads. One downstream server per gateway process.
